neutral.EN: I am still down and waiting for a patch.
neutral.TL: Nasa sahig pa rin ako at naghihintay ng benda.

neutral.EN: Still on the floor. Where is that bandage?
neutral.TL: Nasa sahig pa rin. Nasaan na 'yung benda?

neutral.EN: Wound is still unbandaged. Need it wrapped soon.
neutral.TL: Wala pa ring benda ang sugat. Kailangang balutin na agad.

neutral.EN: Still waiting for someone to bind this cut.
neutral.TL: Naghihintay pa rin ng magtatali sa hiwang 'to.

neutral.EN: Blood is still seeping through. Need that wrap.
neutral.TL: Tumutulo pa rin ang dugo. Kailangan ko ng pambalot.

neutral.EN: Still grounded until these wounds get dressed.
neutral.TL: Bagsak pa rin hangga't hindi nagagamot ang mga sugat na 'to.

neutral.EN: Waiting on clean cloth. Can't stand like this.
neutral.TL: Naghihintay ng malinis na tela. Hindi makatayo nang ganito.

neutral.EN: Still down here waiting for first aid.
neutral.TL: Nandito pa rin sa sahig at naghihintay ng first aid.

neutral.EN: Unpatched and bleeding. Please hurry.
neutral.TL: Walang benda at dumurugo. Pakiusap bilisan mo.

neutral.EN: Still need that dressing applied. Don't delay.
neutral.TL: Kailangan pa ring ilapat ang pambenda. Huwag patagalin.

neutral.EN: The bleeding has not stopped. I still need a bandage.
neutral.TL: Hindi pa tumitigil ang dugo. Kailangan ko pa rin ng benda.

neutral.EN: Still hemorrhaging. I need pressure and a wrap immediately.
neutral.TL: Patuloy pa ring umaagos ang dugo. Kailangan ng diin at benda agad.

neutral.EN: Bleeding is continuing. I'm getting lightheaded.
neutral.TL: Dumurugo pa rin. Nahihilo na ako.

neutral.EN: Blood is still flowing. Please get that bandage on me.
neutral.TL: Umaagos pa rin ang dugo. Pakiusap lagyan mo na ako ng benda.

neutral.EN: Hasn't stopped bleeding yet. Running out of time.
neutral.TL: Hindi pa rin humihinto ang pagdurugo. Nauubusan na ako ng oras.

neutral.EN: Still losing red. My clothes are soaked.
neutral.TL: Nauubusan pa rin ng dugo. Babad na ang damit ko.

neutral.EN: The wound won't seal itself. Need a dressing now.
neutral.TL: Hindi kusang magsasara ang sugat. Kailangan ng benda ngayon din.

neutral.EN: Still bleeding steadily. Hurry up with the aid.
neutral.TL: Tuloy-tuloy pa rin ang pagdurugo. Bilisan mo ang tulong.

neutral.EN: Losing blood by the second. Please hurry.
neutral.TL: Bawat segundo nauubusan ako ng dugo. Pakiusap magmadali ka.

neutral.EN: The cut won't stop bleeding. Wrap it, please.
neutral.TL: Ayaw tumigil ng pagdurugo ng hiwa. Balutin mo na, pakiusap.

neutral.EN: I am still down. I still need help.
neutral.TL: Bagsak pa rin ako. Kailangan ko pa rin ng tulong.

neutral.EN: Still incapacitated on the ground. Please assist.
neutral.TL: Hindi pa rin makakilos sa lupa. Pakiusap tulungan mo ako.

neutral.EN: Haven't recovered yet. Still need a hand.
neutral.TL: Hindi pa nakakabawi. Kailangan pa rin ng saklolo.

neutral.EN: Still down here. Don't leave me alone.
neutral.TL: Nandito pa rin sa sahig. Huwag mo akong iwang mag-isa.

neutral.EN: Status unchanged: still injured and waiting.
neutral.TL: Walang pagbabago: sugatan pa rin at naghihintay.

neutral.EN: Still grounded. I need someone to help me up.
neutral.TL: Bagsak pa rin. Kailangan ko ng tutulong sa akin makatayo.

neutral.EN: Can't move on my own yet. Still need aid.
neutral.TL: Hindi pa makagalaw mag-isa. Kailangan pa rin ng lunas.

neutral.EN: Still unable to stand. Waiting for help.
neutral.TL: Hindi pa rin makatayo. Naghihintay ng tulong.

neutral.EN: I'm still down in the dirt. Please assist me.
neutral.TL: Nasa lupa pa rin ako. Pakiusap saklolohan mo ako.

neutral.EN: Still waiting for support. Don't forget me.
neutral.TL: Naghihintay pa rin ng suporta. Huwag mo akong kalimutan.

neutral.EN: I still need water before I can move.
neutral.TL: Kailangan ko pa rin ng tubig bago makakilos.

neutral.EN: Thirst is still crippling me. Bring hydration.
neutral.TL: Pinapahirapan pa rin ako ng uhaw. Magdala ka ng tubig.

neutral.EN: Can't stand until I drink something clean.
neutral.TL: Hindi makakatayo hangga't hindi umiinom ng malinis.

neutral.EN: Still parched and dizzy. Where is the water?
neutral.TL: Tuyot at nahihilo pa rin. Nasaan na ang tubig?

neutral.EN: Dehydration hasn't improved. I need fluids now.
neutral.TL: Hindi pa gumagaling ang dehydration. Kailangan ko ng inumin ngayon.

neutral.EN: Still desperately thirsty. Bring a bottle over.
neutral.TL: Uhaw na uhaw pa rin ako. Dalhin mo ang bote rito.

neutral.EN: Throat is still locked up dry. Need water.
neutral.TL: Nakatuyot pa rin ang lalamunan ko. Kailangan ng tubig.

neutral.EN: Can't make progress without hydration. Help me.
neutral.TL: Hindi makakausad nang walang tubig. Tulungan mo ako.

neutral.EN: Still waiting on that drink. Feeling very weak.
neutral.TL: Naghihintay pa rin sa inumin. Sobrang nanghihina na.

neutral.EN: Need fluids before my legs will work again.
neutral.TL: Kailangan ng inumin bago gumana ulit ang mga binti ko.

neutral.EN: I still need time to recover my strength.
neutral.TL: Kailangan ko pa ng oras para manumbalik ang lakas ko.

neutral.EN: Stamina is still drained. Catching my breath.
neutral.TL: Ubos pa rin ang stamina. Humihinga pa rin.

neutral.EN: Still exhausted. Give me a little more time.
neutral.TL: Pagod na pagod pa rin. Bigyan mo pa ako ng kaunting oras.

neutral.EN: Muscles are still aching. Recovering slowly.
neutral.TL: Kumikirot pa rin ang kalamnan. Dahan-dahang nagpapagaling.

neutral.EN: Lungs still burning from running. Give me a moment.
neutral.TL: Nasusunog pa rin ang baga sa pagtakbo. Bigyan mo ako ng saglit.

neutral.EN: Fatigue hasn't cleared yet. Still resting here.
neutral.TL: Hindi pa humuhupa ang pagod. Nagpapahinga pa rin dito.

neutral.EN: Energy is very low. Still need a few breaths.
neutral.TL: Napakababa pa ng lakas. Kailangan pa ng ilang malalalim na hininga.

neutral.EN: Legs are still shaking from exhaustion. Give me time.
neutral.TL: Nanginginig pa rin ang mga binti sa pagod. Bigyan mo ako ng oras.

neutral.EN: Still spent. Don't rush me to run again.
neutral.TL: Ubos pa rin. Huwag mo akong apurahin tumakbo ulit.

neutral.EN: Recharging my stamina. Just a little longer.
neutral.TL: Nagpapalakas ulit. Kaunti na lang.

neutral.EN: I am still down. Please do not finish me.
neutral.TL: Bagsak pa rin ako. Pakiusap huwag mo akong tapusin.

neutral.EN: Still helpless here. Spare my life, please.
neutral.TL: Walang laban pa rin dito. Buhayin mo ako, pakiusap.

neutral.EN: I'm still no threat to you. Please have mercy.
neutral.TL: Wala pa rin akong banta sa'yo. Pakiusap maawa ka.

neutral.EN: Still begging for survival. Don't hurt me.
neutral.TL: Nagmamakaawa pa rin para mabuhay. Huwag mo akong saktan.

neutral.EN: Plea remains: spare me and let me crawl away.
neutral.TL: Hiling ko pa rin: buhayin mo ako at hayaang gumapang palayo.

neutral.EN: I surrender completely. Please do not execute me.
neutral.TL: Sumusuko ako nang buo. Pakiusap huwag mo akong patayin.

neutral.EN: Still at your mercy. Please keep that weapon away.
neutral.TL: Nasa awa mo pa rin ako. Pakiusap ilayo mo ang sandata na 'yan.

neutral.EN: I have surrendered. Don't strike a downed person.
neutral.TL: Sumuko na ako. Huwag kang manakit ng taong nakahandusay.

neutral.EN: Please honor your mercy. Don't kill me.
neutral.TL: Pakiusap tuparin mo ang awa mo. Huwag mo akong patayin.

neutral.EN: Still alive, still pleading. Let me survive this.
neutral.TL: Buhay pa, nagmamakaawa pa rin. Hayaan mo akong makaraos dito.

neutral.EN: I am still here. Please come back for me.
neutral.TL: Nandito pa rin ako. Pakiusap balikan mo ako.

neutral.EN: Still trapped in place. Waiting for your rescue.
neutral.TL: Naipit pa rin sa pwesto. Naghihintay sa saklolo mo.

neutral.EN: Don't leave me stranded! I'm still where you left me.
neutral.TL: Huwag mo akong iwang nastranded! Nandito pa rin ako sa iniwanan mo.

neutral.EN: Still cannot walk out alone. Come help me.
neutral.TL: Hindi pa rin makalabas nang mag-isa. Halika tulungan mo ako.

neutral.EN: Waiting on rescue here. Hurry before dead arrive.
neutral.TL: Naghihintay ng saklolo rito. Bilisan mo bago dumating ang mga patay.

neutral.EN: Still pinned down. Please extract me.
neutral.TL: Naiipit pa rin. Pakiusap hilahin mo ako palabas.

neutral.EN: Don't forget me here! Still need someone to pull me out.
neutral.TL: Huwag mo akong kalimutan dito! Kailangan pa rin ng maghihila sa akin.

neutral.EN: Status unchanged: trapped and waiting for assistance.
neutral.TL: Walang pagbabago: naipit at naghihintay ng saklolo.

neutral.EN: Still waiting for someone to drag me to safety.
neutral.TL: Naghihintay pa rin ng hihila sa akin sa ligtas na lugar.

neutral.EN: I'm still right here. Please don't leave me behind.
neutral.TL: Nandito lang ako. Pakiusap huwag mo akong iwan.

neutral.EN: I still need food before I can get up.
neutral.TL: Kailangan ko pa rin ng pagkain bago makatayo.

neutral.EN: Starvation is worsening. Did you find anything edible?
neutral.TL: Lumalala ang gutom ko. May nahanap ka bang makakain?

neutral.EN: Still too weak from hunger to stand.
neutral.TL: Nanghihina pa rin sa gutom para makatayo.

neutral.EN: Can't move on an empty stomach. Bring food.
neutral.TL: Hindi makakilos nang walang laman ang tiyan. Dalhan mo ako ng pagkain.

neutral.EN: Still starving on the floor. Please bring a ration.
neutral.TL: Nagugutom pa rin sa sahig. Pakiusap dalhan mo ako ng rasyon.

neutral.EN: Body needs calories right now. I'm fading.
neutral.TL: Kailangan ng katawan ng pagkain ngayon din. Nanghihina na ako.

neutral.EN: Still waiting for a meal. Stomach cramps are brutal.
neutral.TL: Naghihintay pa rin ng pagkain. Matindi ang pulikat ng tiyan ko.

neutral.EN: Can't regain strength without food. Help me.
neutral.TL: Hindi maibabalik ang lakas nang walang pagkain. Tulungan mo ako.

neutral.EN: Still starving here. Any can of beans or soup?
neutral.TL: Gutom pa rin ako rito. May de-latang beans ba o sabaw?

neutral.EN: Need nourishment before I can take a step.
neutral.TL: Kailangan ko ng makakain bago ako makahakbang.
